description: This PHP class 'FilterUsingXForwardedHeaders' is part of the Laminas Diactoros library. It modifies HTTP server requests to update their URI based on trusted X-Forwarded-* headers, primarily used behind reverse proxies to reconstruct the client's original request details.

classes.name: FilterUsingXForwardedHeaders
classes.description: Final class implementing request filtering based on X-Forwarded-* headers to reflect original client request details behind trusted proxies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor used internally for instantiation with trusted proxies and headers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Transforms the incoming ServerRequestInterface object by modifying its URI based on trusted headers if the request originates from a trusted proxy.

methods.name: trustProxies
methods.description: Static method to create an instance with a specific list of trusted proxy CIDR ranges and headers.

methods.name: trustAny
methods.description: Static method to trust any X-Forwarded-* headers from any address; use with caution.

methods.name: trustReservedSubnets
methods.description: Static method to trust X-Forwarded-* headers from reserved internal network subnets for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: isFromTrustedProxy
methods.description: Checks if a remote IP address matches any of the trusted proxy ranges.

methods.name: validateTrustedHeaders
methods.description: Validates that the provided headers are among allowed X-Forwarded-* headers.

methods.name: normalizeProxiesList
methods.description: Normalizes the list of proxy CIDRs, expanding wildcards to default CIDR ranges.

methods.name: validateProxyCIDR
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a correct IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR notation.
